verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control covering pan, tilt, zoom, dolly and handheld, so creators can direct camera moves rather than leave them to the model. The evidence is a single vendor line in llms.txt with no independent or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit orbit and static/locked-camera options, in-depth docs on how camera control is set (UI or API parameters), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
